subject: Payment accepted but charging did not start
message: At charger CHG-CA-1042, connector 2 accepted payment reference PAY-DEMO-7319 for session SESSION-DEMO-88421 at 14:06 UTC, but the vehicle never began charging. The screen returned to Available after 90 seconds.

subject: Every charger at the demo site appears offline
message: All six chargers at synthetic site SITE-DEMO-TOR-07 show Offline since 09:18 UTC. Charger CHG-CA-2001 last reported a heartbeat at 09:16 UTC and three drivers are waiting.

subject: Connector reports a persistent fault
message: Connector 1 on fictional charger CHG-CA-3110 reports Faulted with demo error code EVSE-DEMO-OVER_CURRENT. Connector 2 is still available and no active session is affected.

subject: OCPP heartbeat timeout after configuration change
message: Synthetic charger CHG-CA-4018 stopped sending OCPP heartbeats after configuration DEMO-CFG-92 was applied. The last heartbeat was 11 minutes ago and the central system now marks it Unavailable.

subject: Driver sees two charges for one session
message: Session SESSION-DEMO-55301 on CHG-CA-5150 completed normally, but the fictional card statement contains payment references PAY-DEMO-1004 and PAY-DEMO-1005 for the same CAD 18.40 amount. The driver is requesting a refund.

subject: Registered RFID card is rejected
message: Demo account ACCT-DEMO-882 uses RFID token RFID-DEMO-A19. The token worked yesterday but authorization was rejected at CHG-CA-6009 today with status Invalid, while mobile-app authorization still works.

subject: Charging power remains below expected rate
message: Session SESSION-DEMO-76112 on fictional charger CHG-CA-7088 has remained near 7 kW for 28 minutes although the connector is rated for 50 kW. Meter samples are arriving normally and no fault is reported.

subject: Receipt requested for a completed session
message: Please send a receipt for fictional session SESSION-DEMO-90817 completed yesterday at CHG-CA-8044. The total was CAD 12.75 and there were no charging problems.

subject: Synthetic provider timeout for retry review
message: This reserved synthetic incident demonstrates one provider timeout before a reviewer retries the durable queue job. No customer, charger, or payment system is connected.
